text: What Silas Brown promises shall be there
why: A neutral name for the thing Brown says 'shall be there', taken directly from ¶140.

text: What has become of the favourite? — in a stable nearby, changed so as not to be known
id: q.horse_where=in a stable nearby, changed so as not to be known
why: Holmes has reasoned the horse is at Mapleton, and Brown asks whether to 'change it first', so a reader can consider that it is hidden there in altered form.

text: What is it that Silas Brown promises shall be there?
why: Brown's 'It shall be there' leaves unsaid what 'it' is, so this is a natural, neutrally worded question.

text: Where is it that Silas Brown promises it shall be?
why: Brown does not say where 'there' is, so this is a natural, neutrally worded question.

text: Where is it that Silas Brown promises it shall be? — at the race for the Wessex Cup on Tuesday
id: q.brown_there=at the race for the Wessex Cup on Tuesday
why: Holmes insisted the horse's name stay in the Cup entries for next Tuesday, which gives a reader reason to consider this.

text: Where is it that Silas Brown promises it shall be? — back at King's Pyland
why: The horse was taken from King's Pyland, so its return there is a natural possibility to consider.

text: What would Silas Brown change before it is there?
why: Brown's 'Should I change it first or not?' directly raises this question.

text: What would Silas Brown change before it is there? — put its appearance back as it was, after it had been altered
id: q.change_it=put its appearance back as it was, after it had been altered
why: 'Change it first' plausibly means undoing an alteration, so this is a reasonable reading of Brown's own words.

text: What would Silas Brown change before it is there? — alter it in some way before handing it over
id: q.change_it=alter it in some way before handing it over
why: This is a plain reading of 'change it first'.
